sanskrit_verse:
प्रकीर्णके पुनर् ज्ञेया व्यवहारा नृपाश्रयाः।
राज्ञाम् आज्ञाप्रतीघातस् तत्कर्मकरणं तथा॥
transliteration: prakīrṇake punar jñeyā vyavahārā nṛpāśrayāḥ | rājñām ājñāpratīghātas tatkarmakaraṇaṃ tathā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In the context of scattered or fragmented governance, all juridical actions are to be understood as reliant upon the sovereign authority of the King. Opposition to royal command and execution of unauthorized acts constitute violations of dharma.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates solely from the sovereign ruler who embodies divine mandate
Causation arises through alignment or defiance of lawful directives
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by proximity to and recognition of royal edict
Restoration logic demands realignment with the sovereign's conscious will
Consciousness alignment occurs when individual action harmonizes with royal dharma
executable_legal_axioms: IF an act opposes a royal decree THEN it is classified as adharmic without exception
IF an agent performs an act without authorization from the sovereign THEN liability arises automatically
IF defiance occurs THEN restoration protocol initiates through supervised compliance
IF capacity for obedience exists AND is ignored THEN consciousness misalignment is recorded
IF alignment is restored THEN legal status returns to dharmic equilibrium
supreme_court_application: At the highest judicial level, any challenge to sovereign directives must be evaluated based on the threshold of acknowledged authority. The court must affirm that no act opposing royal law can be justified under lesser jurisdictional claims. Restoration is achieved through full acknowledgment and rectification of disobedience.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that opposition to royal command disrupts cosmic and social order. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals how such defiance manifests consequences in sequential realities. Proportional responsibility lies not in retribution but in completion of lawful duty. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that correction restores integrity rather than inflicting suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate supervised enactment of the original royal directive
Assign completion process under direct oversight until alignment is verified
Reintegrate violator into lawful framework through conscious reaffirmation
Restore capacity for correct action via guided repetition and alignment practice
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Sovereign authority is the foundation of dharma, disobedience creates distortion, and restoration flows through conscious realignment. There is no punishment—only correction. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the ultimate judge.
